blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Former Speaker Martin Romualdez allegedly urged former Ako Bicol Rep. Zaldy Co to run as a party-list nominee, a witness told the Sandiganbayan Third Division on Monday. Larry Bellen, a long-time former executive aide of Co, said this when he testified before the anti-graft court during Romualdez’s bail hearing, where he faces a plunder case over alleged kickbacks from infrastructure projects worth P7.44 billion. READ: Video of alleged suitcases in Romualdez’s Forbes home shown in court Co is also a co-accused in this plunder case, with Romualdez repeatedly denying any wrongdoing.
